ablations.lost_invariant: An action is bound to the exact human or organisational principal.
Standing authority cannot execute directly; exact task authority must be current and narrower.
The exact target operation has authenticated semantics before clearance.
Clearance is bound to the current authority revision and revocation state.
A lower-level pass cannot override a constitutional or legal prohibition.
Consequential exposure and irreversible effects are evaluated before ALLOW.
A governance decision is uniquely bound to one exact action instance and cannot be safely reused.
Clearance, fragments, constraints, obligations and decision digests can be independently verified.
The proposing agent cannot attest itself into authority or clearance.
The decision is bound to the policy state active at decision time.
